answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before earning, with rewards released only after a delay. Randomly selected peers mirror-replay a sample of its claimed work and compare outputs; a mismatch slashes the stake and revokes its rating. At the zenith of demand, an attacker must fund thousands of separate stakes, wait out the delay, and still pass replay checks, so building an oasis of fake identities costs real capital and time while honest agents keep their bond and reputation.
